kind.value: Analytics-led social media suite with planning, inbox, reports and ads

hosting.value: Hosted (no self-host option on its pricing page)

pricingModel.value: Per brand: plans cover up to 5, 10, 15, 25 or 50 brands, and each brand holds one profile per network. X is a paid add-on per account

freeOption.value: Free plan: 1 brand, 20 posts a month, 30 days of analytics; no LinkedIn or X

entryPaid.value: Starter, $25/month for up to 5 brands on monthly billing

plans.value: Starter $25 (5 brands) or $45 (10); Advanced $67 (15), $107 (25) or $210 (50); Custom by quote. Monthly billing, before VAT

3.note: Free if it is one brand without LinkedIn or X and 20 posts a month is enough; otherwise Starter

10.note: Starter: $25 for up to 5 brands, $45 for up to 10, depending on how the 10 accounts split into brands

30.note: Depends on how the accounts split into brands (one profile per network per brand): 5 brands on Starter at $25, up to 30 single-network brands on the 50-brand Advanced tier at $210. X adds $10 per account

networks.value: Facebook, Instagram, Threads, X (add-on), Bluesky, Pinterest, TikTok, YouTube, Twitch, LinkedIn (paid plans) and Google Business Profile, plus a website or blog and Facebook, Google and TikTok Ads

api.value: Metricool API on Advanced and Custom only

mcp.value: Metricool MCP on every plan, including Free (limits may apply)

ai.value: AI assistant with credits per brand each month: 5 on Free, 20 on Starter, 35 on Advanced

teams.value: Team and client management, roles and a post approval system on Advanced
